arguments.script: System.Collections.IEnumerator Check(){float previous=UnityEngine.Time.timeScale;UnityEngine.Time.timeScale=0;var scene=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.CreateScene("HighLandingAudioTest",new UnityEngine.SceneManagement.CreateSceneParameters(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.LocalPhysicsMode.Physics2D));try{var ground=new UnityEngine.GameObject("Default-layer ground");var gc=ground.AddComponent<UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D>();gc.size=new UnityEngine.Vector2(100,1);UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(ground,scene);var physics=scene.GetPhysicsScene2D();for(int test=0;test<2;test++){var probe=new UnityEngine.GameObject("Body falling probe");probe.layer=UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer("Character");probe.transform.position=new UnityEngine.Vector3(0,.8f,0);var col=probe.AddComponent<UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D>();col.size=UnityEngine.Vector2.one*.2f;var rb=probe.AddComponent<UnityEngine.Rigidbody2D>();rb.gravityScale=0;rb.collisionDetectionMode=UnityEngine.CollisionDetectionMode2D.Continuous;probe.AddComponent<Character.Lifecycle.Death>();var unstuck=probe.GetComponent<PlayerUnstuck>();if(unstuck!=null)unstuck.enabled=false;var impact=probe.AddComponent<Character.ContactSoundEffect>();UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(probe,scene);yield return new UnityEngine.WaitForSecondsRealtime(.5f);if(test==1 && !impact.TryPlayImpact(4f))throw new System.Exception("Could not prime wall-bump cooldown");var router=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<GameplayAudio>();int before=router==null?0:router.PlayCount;rb.velocity=UnityEngine.Vector2.down*(test==0?12:25);impact.SendMessage("FixedUpdate");for(int i=0;i<8;i++)physics.Simulate(.02f);router=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<GameplayAudio>();if(router==null || router.PlayCount!=before+1 || !router.LastClipName.StartsWith("footstep_grass_"))throw new System.Exception("High landing missing/duplicate: case"+test);UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(probe);yield return null;}yield return new UnityEngine.WaitForSecondsRealtime(.15f);GameplayAudio.Play("coin",1f);var audio=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<GameplayAudio>();var cache=(System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string,UnityEngine.AudioClip>)typeof(GameplayAudio).GetField("clips",System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(audio);if(audio.LastClipName!="impactMetal_light_000")throw new System.Exception("Wrong coin sound");if(Character.ContactSoundEffect.ImpactGain(false,2.19f)!=0)throw new System.Exception("Light hammer regression");UnityEngine.Debug.Log("LANDING_COIN_PLAY_PASS: 12/25 downward speeds on Default ground play grass once;hard landing bypasses wall cooldown/dedup;coin route works;light hammer remains silent.");}finally{UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync(scene);UnityEngine.Time.timeScale=previous;}}return Check();
arguments.summary: Verify real high-speed body landings, recent-wall-bump case, coin routing and light-hammer regression in isolated physics
